items.team: AI agent memory for data analysts
items.description: Working on representations for AI agent memory to empower data analysts. Sources include structured and unstructured company data — both directly provided by the company and fetched via authenticated third-party connectors — and the representations include knowledge graphs, extracted skills, table metadata and domain extraction. Built the entire pipeline for incremental ingestion and the serving layer (graph traversal) to provide a cost-effective and smooth experience for consumers.

Research Assistant under Dr. Fernando Diaz. Leveraging granular and implicit human preference feedback through infilling and edits to enhance personalization and reduce cognitive load in comparing LLM-based system outputs. Also contributed to research on population-level trajectory sharing across LLM agent populations (MATM).

Built a full-catalog audio retrieval system for style/emotion transfer in synthetic dubbing. Fine-tuned wav2vec2-2B with contrastive loss for multilingual embeddings and built automated evaluation suites — ~13% improvement in human preference evaluations.
Worked on the bill payments platform powering services like credit card payments, gift cards, vouchers, electricity, education, rent etc., serving 5 million+ monthly transacting users.

internship.description: Made a complete backend microservice from scratch for a new line of utility product on CRED for BNPL (Buy Now, Pay Later).

items.description: Worked on the Account Protection Team whose objective is safeguarding members' privacy and data from different attack vectors like scraping, phishing, replay, and man-in-the-middle attacks. The team also handles the user login experience, maintains session and members' sensitive information.

internship.description: Made APIs for a new architecture for storing phone numbers handling various edge cases. Came up with a clustering algorithm to generate the required number of regexes for phone number validation to replace Google's libphonenumber.

items.description: Worked in close collaboration with the Pfizer team as a client to develop different automated workflows needed for vaccine generation by the researchers at Pfizer.
